_comment: Add your own buttons here. {t} / {target} gets replaced with the target you type. Set needs_scope=true to force the 'are you authorized' confirm before it runs.

tools.label: WHOAMI
tools.cmd: echo HOST: $(hostname); id; ip -brief addr; uptime

tools.label: ARPSCAN
tools.cmd: sudo arp-scan --localnet 2>/dev/null || sudo nmap -sn $(ip route | awk '/default/{print $3}')/24
